rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - annual rent increase cap
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period, and no increase is permitted if the CPI is negative. Owners may petition the City for relief from the cap by showing a larger increase is needed for a fair and reasonable return.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% per year or 80% of the percent change in CPI over the most recent 12-month period; 0% if CPI is negative
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property and mobile home park spaces in Santa Ana, except residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990. Owners may petition for relief from the cap to obtain a fair and reasonable return.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - written notice of tenant rights
rules.requirement: Property owners must provide written notice of the Rent Stabilization Ordinance and tenant's rights at commencement of a lease or as part of any notice to increase rent.
rules.coverage_text: Owners of residential rental property covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Property owners are required to provide written notice of the Ordinance and tenant’s rights at commencement of a lease or as part of any notice to increase rent.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - just cause requirement
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice; just cause includes at-fault causes (such as nonpayment of rent, breach of a material lease term, nuisance, criminal activity) and no-fault causes (owner occupancy, removal from the rental market, demolition or substantial remodel). Before a just cause termination notice, the owner must first give notice of the violation with a period for the tenant to fix it.
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies of more than 30 days in Santa Ana, except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - relocation assistance for no-fault terminations
rules.requirement: For a no-fault just cause termination, the owner must either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: 3 months of relocation assistance or waiver of rent for the final 3 months
rules.coverage_text: No-fault terminations of residential tenancies covered by the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - notice of protections to tenants
rules.requirement: Property owners must notify existing tenants of the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance protections before December 19, 2021, or at commencement or renewal of their lease.
rules.coverage_text: Owners of residential property covered by the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Property owners must provide notice to existing tenants before December 19, 2021, or at commencement or renewal of their lease of the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance protections.
rules.effective_date_phrase: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
